<b>Splinterbarks</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are winged members of the [[Splinter Tribe]] with bulging eyes, large arms, and a flaky shell.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Splinterbarks can normally be found sticking to walls throughout [[Shellwood]], being passive in this state unless [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] gets too close or attacks.<br>
After waking up, Splinterbarks take flight and maintain slight distance from Hornet before flying towards her to close the gap for an attack.<br>
To attack, Splinterbarks become a whirlwind of slashes and swoop down at Hornet.

Splinterbarks deal {{Damage|1}} both with their attack and on contact.

Splinterbarks' attacks can be parried by Hornet's Needle to deflect their momentum and send them away. [[Silkspear]] kills Splinterbarks in a single shot, making it a great way to deal with them before they become a problem.

Up to two Splinterbarks can be summoned by [[Sister Splinter]], and if one dies, she can summon another.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Splinterbarks have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].
